script.title: ಚಾವುಂಡರಾಯ ನೂರಾರು ಕೊಡ ಹಾಲು ಸುರಿದರೂ ವಿಗ್ರಹ ನೆನೆಯಲಿಲ್ಲ ಏಕೆ 🙏
sentences: ಐತಿಹ್ಯದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಚಾವುಂಡರಾಯ ನೂರಾರು ಕೊಡ ಹಾಲು ಸುರಿದರೂ ವಿಗ್ರಹ ನೆನೆಯಲೇ ಇಲ್ಲ.
ಶ್ರವಣಬೆಳಗೊಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಐವತ್ತೇಳು ಅಡಿಯ ಗೋಮಟೇಶ್ವರನನ್ನು ಕೆತ್ತಿಸಿದವನು ಈ ಗಂಗರ ಸೇನಾಪತಿ.
ಮಹಾಮಸ್ತಕಾಭಿಷೇಕದ ವೇಳೆ ಅವನ ಗರ್ವದಿಂದ ಹಾಲು ಹೊಕ್ಕಳ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಹರಿಯಲೇ ಇಲ್ಲ.
ಎಳನೀರು, ಜೇನುತುಪ್ಪ ಮತ್ತು ನೀರು ಸುರಿದರೂ ತೊಟ್ಟು ಕೆಳಗೆ ಇಳಿಯಲಿಲ್ಲ.
ಆಗ ಬಡ ಮುದುಕಿಯ ವೇಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೂಷ್ಮಾಂಡಿನಿ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಬಂದಳು.
ಆಕೆ ಗುಳ್ಳಿಕಾಯಿ ಚಿಪ್ಪಿನಲ್ಲಿದ್ದ ಹಾಲಿನಿಂದ ತಲೆಯಿಂದ ಪಾದದವರೆಗೆ ಅಭಿಷೇಕ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
ಚಾವುಂಡರಾಯ ತನ್ನ ತಪ್ಪು ಅರಿತು ಗರ್ವವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಪೂಜೆ ಮಾಡಿದ.
ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೂರ್ತಿ ದಂಡನಾಯಕನ ಅಹಂಕಾರ ಮುರಿದಿದ್ದು ಹೀಗೆ.
script.description:
ಶ್ರವಣಬೆಳಗೊಳದ ಗೋಮಟೇಶ್ವರನ ಮಹಾಮಸ್ತಕಾಭಿಷೇಕದ ಐತಿಹ್ಯ.
ಚಾವುಂಡರಾಯನ ಅಹಂಕಾರ ಮುರಿದ ಆ ವಿಸ್ಮಯ ಘಟನೆ.
claims_en: According to legend, Chavundaraya poured hundreds of pots of milk, but the liquid failed to drench the statue.
The 57-foot Gommateshwara statue at Shravanabelagola was commissioned by Chavundaraya, a Ganga dynasty commander.
During the Mahamastakabhisheka, due to Chavundaraya's pride, the milk would not flow below the navel of the statue.
Even when tender coconut, nectar, and water were poured, not a drop flowed down below the navel.
Kushmandini appeared disguised as a poor old woman.
She poured milk from the shell of half a Gullikayi fruit, and the milk flowed from head to toe.
Chavundaraya realized his arrogance and performed the abhisheka again without pride.
This is how the stone colossus humbled the military commander's pride.
scenes: Extreme close-up of Chavundaraya's proud face turning into shock and bewilderment, sweat glistening on his brow, looking upward at the giant monolithic statue, dramatic natural lighting on Vindhyagiri hill.

Low-angle wide shot of the 57-foot colossal monolithic granite statue of Gommateshwara standing serene under bright morning sun on Vindhyagiri hill, with Ganga dynasty commander Chavundaraya standing beside it in royal armor.
Medium shot of priests pouring hundreds of earthen pots of pure white milk at the head of the statue, the liquid abruptly stopping right at the navel and refusing to trickle down.
Medium shot showing vessels of tender coconut water, golden honey, and water being emptied in desperate attempts, all pooling stubbornly above the statue's waist.
Wide shot of an elderly, humble woman with a bent back and simple cotton drape walking slowly into the grand ritual area amidst royal spectators.
Close-up of the old woman holding a small white Gullikayi fruit shell, pouring a thin stream of milk that miraculously cascades smoothly from the statue's head all the way to its lotus pedestal.
Medium shot of Chavundaraya falling to his knees on the granite rock, folding his hands in profound humility and repentance, offering prayers without ego.
Majestic low-angle shot of the towering Gommateshwara statue washed completely in milk, radiating peaceful stillness against the open sky.
